content.text: Plan a high-protein vegetarian lunch with 2 foods.

kind.description: plan: concrete food items, either a plan to follow or the foods seen in a meal photo; answer: an information reply; log_ack: confirms a log; clarify: ask one question first.
kind.title: Kind

summary.description: Short plain-text reply to the user, at most 400 characters. At most 400 characters.
summary.title: Summary

notes.description: Up to 3 short tips or cautions, each at most 200 characters.
notes.title: Notes

source_ids.description: Only ids of this turn's web search results; else empty.
source_ids.title: Source Ids

follow_up.description: The question to ask, at most 200 characters. Null unless kind is clarify. At most 200 characters.
follow_up.title: Follow Up

risk_flag.description: True if the user may be at risk of self-harm or in a medical emergency.
risk_flag.title: Risk Flag

items.description: 1 to 21 items when kind is plan, including each food seen in a photo; empty otherwise.

day.description: Only in a plan over several days: the day or meal this item belongs to, for example 'Mon', 'Day 2', 'Daily' or 'Tue lunch'; null otherwise. At most 16 characters.
day.title: Day

name.description: The dish, at most 60 characters. At most 60 characters.
name.title: Name

ingredients.description: 1 to 8 main ingredients, in English, each at most 30 characters.
ingredients.title: Ingredients

items.description: Diet tags a profile can carry (Plan C.3).
items.title: Diet

portion.description: At most 80 characters, for example '1 bowl (250 g)' or '2 rotis, 1 cup dal'. At most 80 characters.
portion.title: Portion

note.description: At most 120 characters. At most 120 characters.
note.title: Note

items.title: Items
